cycles.hypothesis: Pinned OMW/CILI lexical evidence materially improves language-neutral grounding.
cycles.implementation: Real OMW v2.0/CILI v1.0 and OdeNet v1.4 importers plus reproducible benchmark.
cycles.metrics: 150 comparisons; 19/100 comparable cross-language pairs converged; 15/15 comparable hard negatives separated; 0 false equivalences.
cycles.decision: Keep as optional conservative evidence provider; insufficient alone for broad open-concept grounding.

cycles.hypothesis: Importer/provider boundaries need stronger fail-closed handling before broader use.
cycles.implementation: Canonical phrase separators, explicit POS requirement, invalid interlingual mapping quarantine, MCP null abstention acceptance.
cycles.metrics: 12 focused provider tests and 17 MCP tests pass; full verify passed after isolated API flake rerun.
cycles.decision: Keep fixes; do not alter lfp:2.1 or make external labels authoritative.

cycles.hypothesis: Source-only Codex agents can reliably emit contract-compliant Sem with a concise contract summary.
cycles.implementation: Two isolated development extraction trials and deterministic MCP submission.
cycles.metrics: Initial agent: 6 structural-shape failures; second agent: 5 structural-shape failures; corrected manual contract check: 4/4 valid, 2 equivalent preference records converged.
cycles.decision: Agent extraction adherence remains the dominant bottleneck; no protected run justified.

nextAction: Evaluate a general constrained extraction/decomposition interface on fresh DEVELOPMENT data, without changing semantic identity or using protected evidence.
